name: Graffiticode
description: The Graffiticode MCP server gives Claude access to an open, growing catalog of task-specific AI tools. Each tool is powered by a dedicated domain-specific language optimized for a particular task — spreadsheets, assessments, data transformers, and more. Claude interacts entirely through natural language: describe what to create, and a language-specific AI backend generates the result. The tool catalog is dynamic — call list_languages to discover what's available, then create and iterate on content through five simple, language-agnostic tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Graffiticode to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Graffiticode to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.graffiticode.org/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Graffiticode MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Graffiticode provides these MCP tools: create_item, update_item, get_item, list_languages, and get_language_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Graffiticode?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Graffiticode in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Graffiticode requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Graffiticode is developed by Artcompiler Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
